task1.title: Coffee and tea buying and drinking habits in five Australian cities
task1.prompt: The chart below shows the results of a survey about people’s coffee and tea buying and drinking habits in five Australian cities.

chartDesc.title: Coffee and tea buying and drinking habits in five cities in Australia
chartDesc.xAxis: Australian cities (Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide, Hobart)

series.name: Bought fresh coffee in last 4 weeks
Bought instant coffee in last 4 weeks
Went to a café for coffee or tea in last 4 weeks

chartDesc.overview: Going to a café for coffee or tea was the most popular habit in four of the five cities (exceeding 60% in Sydney, Melbourne, and Hobart), whereas buying fresh coffee was consistently the least popular option across all cities. Adelaide was the only city where buying instant coffee slightly surpassed going to a café.
keyFeatures: Melbourne had the highest proportion of residents visiting a café (around 63.3%), closely followed by Hobart (62.7%) and Sydney (61.0%).
Adelaide was the only city where instant coffee (50.0%) was more popular than café visits (49.5%).
Buying fresh coffee was lowest in Brisbane (around 34.3%) and Adelaide (around 34.5%), and highest in Sydney (around 43.8%).

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
